Name: Vampiric Interface
Author: JackR0
Description:
[b][color=#85200c]Vampiric Interface by Jack Rivers

[/color][/b]I have finally finished working on a matching UI mod to match my buildings mod!

[b][color=#85200c]---------------------------------------[/color][/b]

I have added font options to make it easier on the eyes, but kept the white one up in case anyone was fine with how it looked <3

[b]Installation[/b]

[list=1]
[*][b]SMAPI - and requirements[/b]
[/list][b] ﻿ [/b]Make sure SMAPI (Stardew Modding API) and CP (Content Patcher) are downloaded and up to date!

[b] ﻿2. Vampiric Interface[/b]
﻿ Install this mod!

[b] ﻿3. Mod Folder[/b]
﻿ Unzip Vampiric Interface and place it into your mods folder! (It can be in a subfolder if you like to keep things organized.)

[color=#85200c][b]---------------------------------------

[/b][/color]A few things to note:

[list]
[*]I got [i]very[/i] confused trying to change the main font color/font shadow, sooo it was an unsuccessful endeavor, BUT I changed the original red I had into a desaturated version to counter the dark font (Same with the money amount numbers, which turned bright red?)
[*]I'm not sure how to change the title screen background (if there's even a way to do that)
[/list]
If these are dealbreakers for downloading my mod, I apologize! I am new to everything and am figuring stuff out as I go. If anyone knows how to change these things, please let me know <3
